description: Read who reacted to or commented on a public post, FRESH at request time. Costs $0.0012 per live read. Set `kind` to reactions or comments and give one of post_id, share_id or post_url. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

cursor.description: Comments only: opaque cursor from the previous page.

include_replies.description: Comments only: true nests every reply under its comment (up to 100 a comment, with replies_page). Default false. page.total counts replies too when page.total_includes_replies is true.

post_id.description: The post: the post reference the posts read returns (id), its numeric activity id, or its activity, share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.

share_id.description: The post's content id: the share_id the posts read returns, a numeric id, or its share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.

name: post_engagers
title: Read Post Engagers
